jobs.description: About the role Kimchi is Cast AI’s newest product: an agentic platform for running AI workloads. If you are at your best when the playbook is still being written, you will thrive here. This is not a role for maintaining a mature product line. It’s a hands-on, zero-to-one PMM job inside a startup-like team with the backing of a unicorn. You must be curious. You’ll speak directly with early customers, run messaging and channel experiments, and build Kimchi’s ICP and positioning from the ground up. Then you’ll turn that evidence into the business’s first go-to-market playbook. You’ll report to the Director of Product Marketing and work alongside Product, Engineering, and company leadership, with support from Content, Growth, Design, and Sales Enablement as the work scales. As a senior hire, you have the autonomy to identify quick wins independently and the judgment to balance short-term results with a longer-term roadmap. Why Cast AI? Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production. The old way doesn t work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don’t. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation. Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS. Our Global Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day. We re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our London office as part of a Global DoorDash Engineering team (working hybrid, 3 days in the office). This role sits in our Consumer Org, where you ll work on recommendation problems with direct, measurable impact on how customers discover relevant content. You’ll collaborate with experienced scientists and engineers across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt, learning from multiple recommendation systems while helping shape the next generation of the experience. What You ll Be Doing Design, develop and improve recommendation, ranking and retrieval models that surface relevant restaurants, dishes, items and content to customers. jobs.title: Machine Learning Researcher
jobs.description: About the Position Our goals are to give you a real sense of what it s like to work at Jane Street as a Machine Learning Researcher while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. You ll work side by side with experienced ML Researchers on projects that we ve selected for their combination of novel ML ideas and relevance to real-world systematic trading strategies. You ll learn how we think about markets through challenging classes and activities, and practice using established methods alongside our own unique twists to train practical models. At Jane Street, the lines between research, technology, and trading are intentionally blurry, and you’ll have access to petabytes of data, a computing cluster with hundreds of thousands of cores, and a growing GPU cluster containing tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Trading poses unusual challenges—large models and nonstationary datasets in a competitive multi-agent environment—that force us to search for novel techniques. You ll spend the bulk of your internship working closely with full-time machine learning researchers on projects drawn from their own work. You might conduct an end-to-end study of an unexplored dataset, try a new modelling paradigm for a thorny problem, or consider blue-sky approaches that we re still trying to figure out. The problems we work on rarely have clean, definitive answers, and they often require insights from colleagues across the firm with different areas of expertise. Depending on the day, you might be diving deep into market data, tuning hyperparameters, debugging training issues, or analysing the predictions your model makes. Note that given the IP-sensitive nature of machine learning research at Jane Street, it is unlikely that any research findings associated with the internship will be suitable for outside academic publication. About you If you ve never thought about a career in finance, you re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here.

We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. About the team Hi, I'm Mariot, I lead Engineering here at Motorway. We're around 70 engineers across product teams, building the marketplace and all services around that handles hundreds of vehicle transactions every day. We care about delivering value to the business, getting the architecture engineering sound, keeping the production bar high, and being early and deliberate about the technology we adopt. We have been early adopters of GenAI for software engineering, we've built a reputation for that, and we'd like to keep earning it. AI is enabling us to deliver faster at a much higher quality software while easing the maintenance of our existing services. About the role We're looking for a Principal Engineer to set technical direction and evolve engineering practices across Motorway, reporting to the Director of Engineering. This is a broad role: your remit spans multiple product areas and every engineering specialties, and your decisions will shape what we build, what we buy, and what we retire. You'll work with engineering leadership, product, and other functions stakeholders to continuously evolve our overall architecture and practices, and with our senior and staff engineers to turn that direction into working software. You will own our relationships with AWS on the engineering side, our main cloud provider.

jobs.description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Role Overview You will design satellite structure and hardware, and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised and under control as the design matures. Working within a small, multidisciplinary team, you will translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing. Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, including secondary structures (panels, brackets and component mounts), thermal-control hardware, cable and harness routing, and mechanisms. Primary structure experience is welcome. Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, using top-down design and skeleton models to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model. Manage assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released. Run interference and clash checks and maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts. Produce fully dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings and interface control documents using GD&T. Ces évolutions nécessitent de garantir la compatibilité des projets existants avec les nouvelles versions de l'application, tout en préservant l'intégrité des données. L'objectif du stage est de concevoir un framework générique capable d'analyser les différences entre deux versions du logiciel, d'identifier les transformations nécessaires et d'automatiser la migration des projets existants. Les principales missions seront : Analyser l'architecture existante du Track Builder et identifier les éléments impactés par les évolutions de versions. Concevoir et développer un framework générique de migration en C++, basé sur une architecture modulaire, des interfaces génériques et des design patterns adaptés. Étudier et intégrer des mécanismes d'IA générative et de LLM pour analyser automatiquement les différences entre versions (code source, schémas XML/XSD, couches SIG, fichiers de configuration et templates). Développer un moteur de validation automatique permettant de contrôler l'intégrité et la cohérence des projets après migration. Étudier et mettre en œuvre des mécanismes de gestion des erreurs, de rollback et de sécurisation des migrations. Participer à l'intégration du framework dans le processus de développement et le pipeline CI/CD du Track Builder. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Observability
jobs.description: Department: Platform Infrastructure Location: Berlin, Germany Team description You'll join the newly formed Developer Experience team, which improves how around 700 SumUp engineers build, ship, and observe software. The team builds the internal tools, services, and abstractions that make infrastructure invisible to product teams. That includes modernising an observability stack that has grown organically and shaping what useful debugging looks like for both engineers and AI agents. This role is software engineering first and DevOps aware second. You'll define open-ended problems before solving them, and you'll build agreement across product engineering, Cloud Infrastructure and Site Reliability Engineering. What you'll do Design, build and evolve services for developer tooling, such as cost reporting, observability pipelines, internal APIs and command line tools Build and extend the internal observability platform so systems are easy for developers to understand and act on Take ownership of components in the observability stack (Loki, Grafana, Prometheus, Alloy and exporters) and improve them Explore what telemetry and debugging context AI agents need, compared with human engineers Create automation, self-service features, and integrations that reduce manual work for product engineering teams Lead design discussions, write and review RFCs, mentor mid-level and junior engineers, and raise standards through code review What you'll bring Strong software engineering fundamentals (Go preferred), with a proven track record of shipping production backend services, command-line tools, or platform tooling. Solid understanding of observability and OpenTelemetry (metrics, logs, traces, SLIs and SLOs) and hands-on experience building observability tooling or integrations. Denn wir suchen für 15-20 Stunden pro Woche eine/n engagierte/n Werkstudent/in im Bereich Marketing. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, in einem dynamischen Team an vielseitigen Projekten mitzuwirken und deine kreativen Ideen einzubringen. Zu uns: Die Volt Venture GmbH ist ein mittelständisches Unternehmen aus Münster, das mit der Marke Clevertronic im Re-Commerce Bereich erfolgreich ist. Clevertronic ist der Rundum-Partner fürs Smartphone-Leben: Wir kaufen gebrauchte Smartphones, Tablets und weitere Elektronik an, bereiten sie professionell auf und geben ihnen als geprüfte Refurbished-Produkte ein zweites Leben. Mit rund 100 Kolleg:innen, mehr als 50 Mio. Euro Umsatz und profitablem Wachstum ohne Investoren gehören wir zu den größten Refurbishing-Unternehmen Deutschlands. Jetzt entwickeln wir Clevertronic zu einer Plattform rund ums Smartphone-Leben weiter - mit neuen Produkten, Geschäftsmodellen und Märkten. Aufgaben Als Werkstudent/in Marketing bei Clevertronic erwarten dich vielfältige und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben: Content Creation : Verfassen von SEO-optimierten Texten, Blogbeiträgen und Landingpages, die unsere Zielgruppe ansprechen und unsere Online-Präsenz stärken Social Media Management : Erstellen und Planen von ansprechenden Social Media Beiträgen für unsere verschiedenen Kanäle E-Mail-Marketing : Gestaltung und Versand von Newslettern, die unsere Kunden begeistern und informieren Marktanalyse : Unterstützung bei der Analyse von Markttrends und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten, um unsere Marketingstrategie stetig zu verbessern Projektarbeit : Mitarbeit an verschiedenen Marketingprojekten, von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung Qualifikation Was du mitbringen solltest: Eingeschriebene/r Student/in im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikationswissenschaften, BWL oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang Erste Erfahrung im Bere

jobs.title: Technical Implementation Manager / Chef.fe de Projet Déploiement Technique
jobs.description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, deux choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé. 🧩 Notre équipe Customer Operations L'équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement de nos solutions Lifen Documents et Lifen Intégration . Composée de Project Managers et d'Operations Managers, et pilotée par Loïc, elle fait le lien entre nos produits et les équipes hospitalières. Nous recherchons un Technical Implementation Manager , à la croisée de la technique et de la gestion de projet, capable de piloter des déploiements clients tout en prenant en main leur intégration technique. 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous Tu seras responsable de l'implémentation technique de nos solutions dans les établissements de santé, du cadrage jusqu'à la mise en production. 🔧 Piloter les déploiements techniques Installer et configurer nos applications dans les environnements clients. Mettre en place les flux d'interopérabilité (notamment HL7).

jobs.title: Senior SAP / ABAP Engineer
jobs.description: You'll own the layer where Causa Prima meets the SAP systems our customers run their finance on. Most of the data we care about lives inside S/4HANA and ECC, and you'll be the person who decides how we read from and write to those systems safely, at scale, across very different customer landscapes. What you'll do Own the add-on: Architectural ownership of our ABAP add-on in its registered namespace: how it's structured, released, and kept upgrade-safe. SAP data and APIs: Design how financial data moves in and out of SAP (OData, BAPIs, RFCs, IDocs) at production volume. FI/CO domain leadership: Turn accounting reality into code: posting logic, payment terms and Skonto, open item management, account determination, tax codes. Reliability and auditability: Build for idempotency, reconciliation, and traceability, so every action against a customer system is explainable after the fact. Customer-facing technical lead: Lead technical discovery and onboarding with finance teams, SAP admins, and customer Basis teams. What we're looking for At least 6 years of hands-on ABAP development on S/4HANA and ECC (not configuration with some coding attached). jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (f/m/d)
jobs.description: This is for the person who's looking for their next growth challenge in recruiting. You can close a hard search, you know how to talk to candidates who aren't looking, and your current role has started to feel a little too comfortable. At eleQtron, you can still help write our next chapter and decide how we get there. We build quantum computers, with about 130 people across Hamburg and Siegen. Most of the people we need are physicists, engineers and software specialists who are sought-after talent. We’re still shaping how eleQtron finds them, how it tells them why they should join, and how we evolve our approach to hiring. That's the job you can define. What you'll do You'll sit inside our technical teams as their talent partner. You'll learn how each team works, where it’s strong and where the gaps are. You'll shape the brief and the bar with the hiring manager, pushing back where you have to. You'll run our hardest searches yourself, from mapping the market to closing the offer and helping people relocate. Most of those hires will be people you found rather than people who applied. With the team, you'll work out why a strong scientist or engineer should join eleQtron, and you'll make sure the people we want to hire hear it, through universities, conferences and research networks as well as the usual (and unusual) channels. You'll build the way we hire: structured interviews, scorecards and debriefs that every technical team uses, with the data to show whether they work. You'll coach our hiring managers and interviewers to that standard. You'll have the freedom to be creative in how you source, and to use AI for the research and admin, so your time goes on judgement and on conversations with people. This is for you if You've outgrown your current role and want to build something. You start things without waiting to be asked, and you finish them. You move with urgency when the picture is still unclear. You'd rather shape an employer brand than inherit one. Hard tech

jobs.title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
jobs.description: TopChrono , leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies. Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous ! Ce que nous vous offrons Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs). Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière. Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement. Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation. Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact ! TOPCHRONO s’engage en faveur de l’inclusion et de l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap. Tous nos postes leur sont ouverts. Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes : Rattachement hiérarchique • Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au niveau national. Mission principale Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. jobs.title: Senior SAP S/4HANA Interface Cutover Lead (Freelance)
jobs.description: Mandatory Expertise – Bitte vor der Bewerbung lesen Für ein langfristiges SAP S/4HANA-Transformationsprogramm bei einem großen deutschen Unternehmen suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior SAP Interface Cutover Lead. Im Rahmen der Transformation von SAP ECC auf SAP S/4HANA müssen rund 800 Schnittstellen zwischen SAP- und Non-SAP-Systemen koordiniert und im Zuge des Cutovers in die neue Systemlandschaft überführt werden. Ein Großteil der erforderlichen technischen Anpassungen wurde bereits umgesetzt. Gesucht wird ein erfahrener Experte, der den gesamten Schnittstellen-Workstream im Cutover eigenverantwortlich plant, koordiniert und steuert. Drei zwingende Anforderungen: SAP Interface Cutover Management: Nachweisbare persönliche Verantwortung für die Planung und Durchführung eines schnittstellenbezogenen Cutovers innerhalb komplexer SAP-Transformations-, Migrations- oder Carve-out-Projekte. Technisches Schnittstellenverständnis: Fundiertes Verständnis von SAP- und Non-SAP-Integrationen, Schnittstellenabhängigkeiten, Middleware-Technologien sowie der Deaktivierung, Umschaltung, Aktivierung und Validierung von Schnittstellen. Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung: Erfahrung in der Koordination technischer Teams, externer Dienstleister und verschiedener Stakeholder innerhalb großer Transformationsprogramme. Es handelt sich nicht um eine reine SAP-Cutover-Management-Rolle, eine klassische Datenmigrationsrolle oder eine Schnittstellenentwicklerposition. Entscheidend ist die Kombination aus Cutover Management, technischer Integrationskompetenz und eigenverantwortlicher Workstream-Steuerung. Bitte bewirb Dich nur, wenn Du konkrete Projektreferenzen in diesem Umfeld vorweisen kannst. Rahmenbedingungen Start: ASAP Laufzeit: bis Ende März 2028 Auslastung: 100 % Einsatzort: 80 % remote, 20 % Frankfurt am Main Sprache: sehr gutes Deutsch Level: Senior / Lead Vertragsart: Freelance / B2B Bevorzugt Experten mit Standort in Deutschland Tasks Eigenverantwortliche Planung, Koordination und Steuer

Train models that work with classical methods, such as initial guesses and learned costs for trajectory optimization, plan quality and feasibility predictors, and learned collision models. Develop viewpoint planning policies that choose where and how to scan, and predict scan quality before the robot commits. Apply imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and generative models such as diffusion and flow matching where they outperform classical baselines. Build production ML pipelines: datasets from fleet logs and simulation, training, and metrics. Evaluate models in the loop, with offline metrics that predict gains on the robot, failure-mode analysis, and calibrated confidence that determines when the system falls back to classical methods. jobs.description: Chez Lowit, nous avons une ambition : accélérer et massifier la transition énergétique des bâtiments tertiaires. Face à la hausse des coûts de l'énergie, aux enjeux climatiques et aux évolutions réglementaires, les gestionnaires de patrimoine ont besoin d'outils fiables, mais aussi d'un accompagnement de qualité pour passer à l'action. Für die strategische Weiterentwicklung unserer Gruppe suchen wir eine Führungspersönlichkeit, die medizinische Versorgungsziele, wirtschaftliche Anforderungen und rechtliche Rahmenbedingungen zusammenführt. Sie beraten die Geschäftsführung bei der strategischen Ausrichtung der Gruppe und begleiten die Umsetzung der daraus abgeleiteten Maßnahmen. Den Fachabteilungen und Mitarbeitenden stehen Sie als Ansprechperson für rechtliche Fragen des Praxisbetriebs zur Seite. Darüber hinaus begleiten Sie Praxen vonder Übernahme bis zur Integration (PMI) in die bestehenden Versorgungs- und Organisationsstrukturen. Ihre Aufgaben · Strategische Unternehmensentwicklung – Sie beraten die Geschäftsführung zu Leistungsangebot, Standorten und Organisation und erarbeiten mit der ärztlichen Leitung und der Finanzleitung Entscheidungsvorlagen für Geschäftsführung und Eigentümer. · Standortübergreifende Projekte – Sie leiten strategische Projekte, stimmen Ziele, Zuständigkeiten und Termine ab und berichten der Geschäftsführung über Fortschritte und Entscheidungsbedarf. · Rechtliche Beratung im Praxisbetrieb – Sie beraten Geschäftsführung, Fachabteilungen und Standortleitungen zu KV- und Zulassungsfragen sowie zum ärztlichen Berufsrecht. Arbeitsrechtliche Fragen klären Sie mit der Personalabteilung. · Vertragsgestaltung und Ausschreibungen – Sie gestalten, prüfen und verhandeln Dienstleistungs-, Liefer- und Kooperationsverträge und begleiten Ausschreibungen bis zum Vertragsabschluss. · Zusammenarbeit mit externen Rechtsberatern – Sie koordinieren externe Kanzleien, bereiten Rechtsfragen auf und unterstützen die Fachabteilungen bei der Umsetzung der Empfehlungen. · Kooperationen und Praxisübernahmen – Sie begleiten die wirtschaftliche und rechtliche Prüfung und koordinieren bei Übernahmen mit der Standortleitung die Integration bei laufender Patientenversorgung. jobs.description: Die MVZ Krause Gruppe ist ein ärztlich geführter Verbund ambulanter Praxen mit rund 200 Mitarbeitenden in Dortmund und der Region. Sie leiten den zentralen Personalbereich und gestalten mit der Geschäftsführung, den ärztlichen Leitungen und den Praxisleitungen die Zusammenarbeit in der wachsenden Gruppe. Ihre Aufgaben • Personalbereich und Strategie. Sie führen das Personalteam fachlich und disziplinarisch und fördern seine Entwicklung. Aus der Unternehmensstrategie leiten Sie Prioritäten für die Personalarbeit ab und beraten die Geschäftsführung bei Personal- und Organisationsentscheidungen. • Organisation und Veränderung. Mit den Leitungen klären Sie, wer am Standort und wer zentral entscheidet. Sie gestalten Rollen, Führungsspannen und Entscheidungswege. Bei Praxisübernahmen begleiten Sie die Beschäftigten von den ersten Gesprächen bis zur Integration in die Gruppe. • Digitalisierung und KI. Mit IT und Praxisteams prüfen Sie, wie z.B. digitale Terminvergabe oder KI-gestützte Telefonie Aufgaben und Schnittstellen verändern. Sie vereinfachen Abläufe über Bereichsgrenzen hinweg, erproben neue Arbeitsweisen und schulen die Teams für den Einsatz im Alltag. • Personalplanung und Gewinnung. Mit den Standorten ermitteln Sie den Bedarf an ärztlichen und nichtärztlichen Fachkräften. Stellenplan und Personalkosten stimmen Sie mit der kaufmännischen Abteilung ab. jobs.description: Brænder du for brands, tænker du iværksætteragtigt, og har du energien til virkelig at sætte gang i tingene? Wenn du nicht nur Kampagnen verwalten, sondern als starker Sparring-Partner echte unternehmerische Erfolge vor Ort mitgestalten willst, dann bist du hier genau richtig. Wir suchen eine proaktive Macher-Persönlichkeit mit Teamgeist, die unsere internationale dänische Design-Marke im deutschen Markt auf das nächste Level hebt – und unsere Franchisenehmer zu echten „Local Heroes“ macht! Hier wirst du sicherlich nicht jeden Tag dasselbe machen, du wirst viel allein arbeiten, aber immer im Austausch mit dem Team, den Stores und Agenturen stehen, du wirst reisen und kannst dich auf ein internationales Umfeld freuen, in dem du persönlich wie fachlich wachsen kannst. Dein zukünftiger Arbeitgeber Unser Auftraggeber ist ein international tätiges Unternehmen aus dem Küchen- und Einrichtungsumfeld, das für Preistransparenz, Nachhaltigkeit und Qualität steht. Das aus Dänemark stammende Konzept besteht seit 1983, ist heute mit mehr als 180 Studios in 13 Ländern vertreten und eines der digitalsten Unternehmen der Branche. Du hast Lust, uns zu unterstützen und mit uns gemeinsam zu wachsen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Aufgaben Retail-Marketing: Du adaptierst unsere internationale Marketingstrategie für den deutschen Markt, steuerst nationale wie regionale Kampagnen und sorgst durch gezielte Initiativen für volle Showrooms und messbaren ROI bei Neueröffnungen sowie Bestands-Stores. Local Hero Marketing: Du entwickelst individuelle lokale Konzepte, aktivierst regionale Medien, Events sowie Kooperationen und stärkst die Sichtbarkeit unserer Franchisenehmer direkt in ihren Communities. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment
jobs.description: About Nivoda Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started. Our Mission For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry. The Fulfilment & Express Team The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world. About the Role As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead. What would YOU be doing? We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. Our team of 500 comes from all corners of the world; we drive things forward collaboratively, take personal responsibility, value positive critical thinking, and persistently serve our customers and planet. jobs.title: Software Provisioning and E/E Vehicle Integration Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Join Quantum-Systems and keep our autonomous ground vehicles on the latest software, every day. You flash, update, and bring up our prototypes (Mandrill UGV and autonomous trucks), find out why something does not work, and make sure it works next time without you. You work AI native: you let agentic tools write the scripts that turn manual steps into one command. Why this role matters? A prototype is only as good as the software running on it. You make sure our engineers test the latest version, on a vehicle that works, with data that explains what happened. What is your Day to Day Mission: Provision Software and Firmware Flash new software releases and firmware onto vehicle computers, ECUs, sensors, and radios; verify the result and roll back safely when needed. Keep a clean record of which vehicle runs which software, firmware, and configuration. Turn manual provisioning into repeatable, scripted, documented procedures. Integrate and Troubleshoot the E/E System Bring up and commission compute, ECUs, sensors, and vehicle networks (CAN / CAN FD, automotive Ethernet). Find faults systematically across hardware, wiring, network, and software, using multimeter, oscilloscope, and bus tools. Support sensor swaps, harness changes, and upfits on prototype vehicles. Pull Logs and Find Root Causes Collect logs, traces, and recordings from the vehicle, work through them, and isolate the root cause. If you cannot fix it yourself, hand engineering a precise, reproducible report; then confirm the fix on the vehicle. Automate with AI Use agentic coding workflows (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) to build scripts and tools for flashing, health checks, and log analysis. Be creative: find pragmatic solutions where no procedure exists yet, and share what works with the team. What you bring to the team: Engineering degree (electrical engineering, mechatronics, computer science, vehicle technology, or similar) or state certified Techniker / Meister with relevant practical experience. Knowledge of RTOS, Ethernet, and hardware abstraction layers. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills in cross-functional, OEM-collaborative environments. Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively across hardware, software, and systems teams. jobs.title: HR-Stagiair(e)
jobs.description: Als HR‑Stagiair(e) draai je bij ons mee in het HR‑team en krijg je de kans om veel te leren, met een duidelijke focus op Learning & Development. Je werkt mee aan verschillende HR- en L&D‑activiteiten en krijgt daarnaast de ruimte om je stage zelf vorm te geven en te ontdekken welke andere HR‑onderwerpen jou aanspreken. Zo doe je brede praktijkervaring op in een omgeving waar veel gebeurt en waar je actief kunt bijdragen. Jouw stage: Je werkt mee in ons team van 10 HR‑professionals met expertise in o.a. onboarding, L&D, verzuim, recruitment, employer branding en HR‑advies. Je krijgt veel vrijheid én goede begeleiding om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Waar draag je aan bij? Het versterken van vaardigheden en ontwikkeling binnen de organisatie door mee te werken aan L&D‑projecten. Het soepel laten verlopen van soft skills trainingen, door ondersteuning bij voorbereiding, communicatie en coördinatie. De verbetering van HR‑processen door het initiëren en uitvoeren van eigen HR‑projecten (bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van onboarding, recruitment of procesoptimalisatie). Events rondom arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, workshops rond duurzame inzetbaarheid en onboardingsactiviteiten. Een correcte en overzichtelijke HR‑administratie, zoals het opstellen van contracten, brieven en personele mutaties. Continue verbetering binnen HR door actieve deelname aan HR‑overleggen en het meedenken over verbeteringen. Onze organisatie beweegt snel: er gebeurt veel en geen week is hetzelfde. Dat biedt enorm veel leerkansen, maar vraagt ook dat jij zelf richting geeft aan je stage en je weg vindt in een dynamische omgeving. Je krijgt van ons goede begeleiding, maar het is aan jou om kansen te zien en initiatief te tonen. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken een stagiair(e) die: Een hbo‑opleiding HRM volgt (3e of 4e jaar) en stage wil lopen vanaf februari 2027. Beschikbaar is voor 4 of 5 dagen per week. Geïnteresseerd is in Learning & Development. Sterk is in Nederlands en goed overweg kan met Engels. Nauwkeurig werkt

Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive. As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in. Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow. About the role Aquablu's products run Android in more places than your pocket. Our dispensing systems ship with Android-powered on-device software that hundreds of thousands of people touch every day, and our mobile apps put hydration in users' hands. As our Android Engineer, you work across that whole surface. Your main arena is on-device: the software running on the hardware itself, where Android meets the physical world. Screens people tap on a machine, software that talks to firmware, updates that roll out to hundreds of deployed systems in the field. Alongside that, you contribute to our mobile development where the products need it. Few Android roles give you this range. This is a hands-on engineering role in a small, fast team. You own features end to end and deliver them reliably, reaching out to your manager when support is needed to unblock you. You build with AI agents as your default collaborator, you work cross-functionally with hardware, firmware, and product, proactively identifying and reaching out to key players that can help filling any gaps. jobs.description: Build the software behind large-scale battery storage Solar and wind power are not always available when we need electricity. Large-scale battery storage helps by storing electricity when supply is abundant and releasing it when demand rises. This keeps the grid flexible and reduces reliance on fossil fuels. But how do you connect a battery site of hundreds of megawatts to a central IT platform? And how do you build software that is ready for the projects still to come? As a Software Engineer at GIGA Storage, these are the challenges you will work on. About GIGA Storage Founded in 2018, we are an international scale-up growing across the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. Our purpose, ‘Unlock every Green Watt’, is about making the energy system better and more affordable for future generations. We aim to have 1.5 to 2 GW of battery power operational by 2030. At 2 GW, that is theoretically enough peak power to supply more than a million homes simultaneously. We pioneer at a scale where many solutions are still being developed. We take ownership, share knowledge and make decisions together. Rapid growth also calls for adaptability: priorities shift and not everything is defined in advance. Your role You develop and grow our Giga platform. You build software in Python, working with technologies including SQL, Terraform, Grafana and data processing. You do not need to know everything already: you enjoy learning beyond your own specialism. What will you work on? At the same time, you strengthen the foundations: fewer manual steps, better-documented code and reusable solutions for future sites. We work by the principle ‘you build it, you run it’. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Sampai dengan hari ini, Bank Mandiri meneruskan tradisi selama lebih dari 140 tahun memberikan kontribusi dalam dunia perbankan dan perekonomian Indonesia. jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri Taspen atau Bank Mantap adalah anak usaha Bank Mandiri yang terutama menyediakan jasa keuangan untuk pensiunan. Untuk mendukung kegiatan bisnisnya, hingga akhir tahun 2020, perusahaan ini memiliki 41 kantor cabang, 64 kantor cabang pembantu, 112 kantor kas, 3 kantor fungsional UMK, 53 kantor fungsional non operasional, dan 152 mobil kas yang tersebar di seantero Indonesia. Lowongan Kerja Bank Mandiri Taspen. Bank ini memulai sejarahnya di Denpasar pada tanggal 23 Februari 1970 sebagai sebuah Maskapai Andil Indonesia (MAI) dengan nama Bank Pasar Sinar Harapan Bali. Pada tanggal 3 November 1992, badan hukum bank ini diubah menjadi Perseroan Terbatas (PT) dengan nama Bank Sinar Harapan Bali. Pada tanggal 10 Maret 1994, bank ini ditetapkan sebagai sebuah bank umum. Pada tahun 2005, terbit peraturan baru dari Bank Indonesia yang mewajibkan bank umum untuk memiliki modal inti setidaknya sebanyak Rp 80 miliar paling lambat pada tanggal 31 Desember 2007. Senior UI/UX Designer
jobs.description: Two designers. 20,000+ doctors. Millions of patients. That's our current ratio of team to impact. If you've worked on teams where your designs disappeared into endless review cycles, this is the opposite. SeriousMD and NowServing are healthcare products that people actually use daily. We need a Senior UI/UX Designer who can own product areas end-to-end, from research to shipped pixels. About Us Leapfroggr builds SeriousMD (the EMR platform Filipino doctors trust) and NowServing (connecting patients to providers nationwide). Our products handle real medical records, real appointments, real patient care. We're a small team by design. No layers, no approvals queue, no "let's circle back." You'll work directly with our Design Lead, engineers, and founders. What you design this week can ship next week. What You'll Actually Do Own UI/UX design for entire product areas across web, iOS, and Android. Take features from user research through wireframes through polished UI through shipped product. Build and extend our design system — we care about consistency at scale. Collaborate daily with engineering to make sure what ships matches what you designed. Run usability tests with real doctors and patients, then iterate based on what you learn. Present your work, defend your decisions, and stay open when you're wrong. What We Offer Remote-friendly (distributed across the Philippines) Health insurance Flexible hours Paid leave (sick, vacation, maternity/paternity, bereavement) Real ownership — your name is on the work, and the work matters How to Apply Send your portfolio showing your process, not just final screens. Tell us which of our products (SeriousMD or NowServing) you'd want to work on first, and why.
